title: Services offered
text: Northstar Clinic offers initial consultations, follow-up visits, therapeutic massage, and mobility sessions. Service suitability is confirmed by qualified staff; the assistant does not diagnose conditions.

title: Business hours
text: The clinic is open Monday through Friday from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM and Saturday from 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM. It is closed on Sunday.

title: Scheduling policy
text: Appointment requests are not confirmed until a staff member verifies availability. Customers should provide a preferred date, time window, service, and callback number.

title: Payment and insurance
text: The clinic accepts major credit cards and HSA or FSA cards. Insurance benefits vary, and staff must verify eligibility before quoting coverage or patient responsibility.

title: Cancellation policy
text: Customers should contact the clinic at least 24 hours before an appointment to cancel or request a new time. A staff member confirms all changes.

title: 服务项目
text: Northstar Clinic 提供初次咨询、复诊、推拿和活动能力训练。具体项目是否适合客户须由专业人员确认；助手不会进行诊断。

title: 营业时间
text: 诊所周一至周五上午九点到下午六点营业，周六上午十点到下午三点营业，周日休息。

title: 付款与保险
text: 诊所接受主要信用卡以及 HSA 或 FSA 卡。保险福利因人而异，工作人员核验后才能说明保险范围和个人费用。
